description: dev compose file with nuxt and postgres that follows all rules passes

tool_input.content:
name: dev-${APP_NAME:-shop}

services:
  nuxt:
    container_name: ${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-nuxt
    image: node:24-alpine
    user: "${UID:-1000}:${GID:-1000}"
    command: sh -c "npm install && npm run dev"
    volumes:
      - ./:/app
  postgres:
    container_name: ${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-postgres
    image: postgres:18-alpine
    user: "${UID:-1000}:${GID:-1000}"
    volumes:
      - ./.data/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql

description: prod compose file in deploy/ that follows all rules passes

tool_input.content:
name: ${APP_NAME:-shop}

services:
  node:
    container_name: ${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-node
    build:
      context: ..
      dockerfile: deploy/Dockerfile
    env_file:
      - path: .env
        required: false
    restart: unless-stopped
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT:-80}:3000"
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
  postgres:
    container_name: ${COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME}-postgres
    image: postgres:18-alpine
    environment:
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ${DB_PASSWORD:?set DB_PASSWORD in deploy/.env}
    volumes:
      - ${DATA_DIR:-./data}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql
